description: This file implements a search interface component for the Notesnook app, including search logic, UI rendering, and interaction with the database for notes, tags, and notebooks.

classes.name: useNotebookExpandedStore
classes.description: A Zustand store managing the expanded/collapsed state of notebooks in the search UI.

classes.name: NotebookItem
classes.description: Component representing a notebook item in the search results, supporting nested notebooks and selection.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: Component representing a note or tag item in the search results, supporting selection and locking.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Main search component providing UI and logic for searching notes, notebooks, and tags within the app.
